title: VXAce Is there a Delta-Time script?

posts.author: AndresTGamesVX
posts.body:
Heya! I'd like to make some part of my videogame being in sync with a BGM, but I want every kind of computer to play it in sync. RPG Maker VX Ace goes by 60 fps, so I don't want a 30 fps computer to play the game 2x slower than the BGM, I want a 30 fps computer to process the game at the same time as the BGM, by skipping the ammount of frames that it needs to skip to keep the track of the BGM.
So, is it possible for RPG Maker VX Ace (Ruby scripting) to add a script that sepparates the "graphics" from the "game process" and makes the system move by Delta-Time? If someone tells me I'll be SOOO grateful!!
(I feel that it's possible to do this, and if it's not..., well, I'll get my methods to make that part where the game is in syncro with the music...)

That's not possible at the script level but there are alternative runtimes of the game engine, such as
mkxp-z
, which provide
something
that may help you.
But delta time isn't the right approach to sync BGM with in-game happenings.
